title: S001k 傍點：元素與字體樣式
reproduces: text-emphasis marks on Aozora's <em class="sesame_dot"> and on em, i, b and strong, upright and italic (Aozora plan Task 6). S001i reads no marks on its one em row, in two runs; this fixture measures the same markup elsewhere, where WebKit draws them as on a span. Each data-ink="emphasis" element's marks are measured alone by making text-emphasis-color transparent.
